AI Agent Engineer, Nykaa — Nov 2025 - Present
Developed and deployed AI-driven shopping assistant prototypes integrated into Nykaa's web storefront to improve product discovery and checkout conversions. Built retrieval-augmented generation pipelines using LangChain to surface product catalogs and knowledge base content stored in Confluence, reducing average user query resolution time in pilot tests. Implemented server-side components and client SDKs in TypeScript to orchestrate multi-turn agent flows, monitor model latency, and log user interactions for analytics. Tuned prompts and managed model calls to Large Language Models to increase relevant suggestion rate in A/B experiments. Collaborated with product and engineering teams on rollout plans and created Confluence documentation for agent behaviors and operational runbooks.

Skills: Python 3, Large Language Models, TypeScript, LangChain, Confluence

Education: B.Com, Narsee Monjee College
